portfolio.name: Health Cloud Initiative Paramedical and Mental Health Portfolio

products.name: HCI One Multidisciplinary Paramedical Platform
products.type: Paramedical Practice Platform (Multidisciplinary EPD and Agenda)
products.description: HCI's new multidisciplinary paramedical platform, built on the web-based FysioRoadmap foundation, that consolidates the acquired labels FysioRoadmap, SpotOnMedics, Incura, Evry, Abakus, Podofile, Edevop and FysioLogic into one product with 'the best of every label'. It combines the agenda as the central hub of the practice, 24/7 online booking, discipline-specific care pathways and guideline templates, voice-to-text documentation, measurement instruments, GDS801 declarations through Vecozo, patient invoicing with Mollie, practice BI and monthly quality data delivery to LDF and Keurmerk. The rollout is phased per discipline, physiotherapy first, with no forced migration deadline for the existing labels; migration is planned and executed together with HCI's implementation team. HCI publishes no list prices: practices receive a custom quote based on the number of therapists, modules and integrations.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Moves the practice from its current label to one platform with agenda, dossier and declarations in a single flow, without losing the features it relies on today.

primaryCustomers.name: Allied Health Therapist
primaryCustomers.description: Gets discipline-specific care pathways and declaration rules for speech therapy, occupational therapy, exercise therapy, dietetics and podiatry on the same platform as the physiotherapists it works with.

products.name: FysioRoadmap Physiotherapy EPD and Agenda
products.description: The web-based physiotherapy EPD and practice management system that serves as the technical foundation of HCI One. The agenda is the central heart of the practice: treatments registered in the agenda generate the invoices and declarations that are submitted to insurers through Vecozo, and the dossier follows KNGF guideline-based templates with measurement instruments. FysioRoadmap connects to partners such as Physitrack, FysioTopics, Qualiview, Twinfield, Fysiovergoeding and ZorgMail and delivers pseudonymised data to the Landelijke Database Fysiotherapie. HCI quotes prices per practice rather than publishing a list price.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Runs agenda, dossier and declarations in one web application whose guideline templates and quality data delivery keep the practice audit-ready with less typing.

products.name: SpotOnMedics Physiotherapy Practice Software
products.description: Physiotherapy practice software founded in 2011 in Hoofddorp, acquired by HCI from VvAA in August 2024, after which HCI described itself as market leader in physiotherapy software supporting one in four paramedics. SpotOnMedics offers 24/7 online booking synchronised with the agenda, a mobile agenda, BI tooling, specialisation cards per treatment type, group management for lessons and subscriptions, Mollie payments on patient invoices and outsourced billing services that take over declaration and return-message handling. It runs in an EU cloud and will be consolidated into HCI One in the physiotherapy phase. SpotOnMedics quotes a custom price within one business day based on the number of therapists and modules; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Fills the agenda through online booking, sees practice production in the BI dashboards and can hand declarations and return messages to the billing service.

products.name: Incura Multidisciplinary Paramedical EPD
products.description: The multidisciplinary EPD founded by HCI initiator Eric de Boer, used by about 7,500 healthcare providers for physiotherapy, speech therapy, occupational therapy, exercise therapy and dietetics, reaching more than 2 million patients over some 20 years. Incura covers agenda, dossier with care pathways per discipline, measurement instruments, declarations through Vecozo and patient invoicing, and connects to partners including Physitrack, Mollie, Abakus, Kiwa, KNGF, Philips, MediQuest and QualiView. Its multidisciplinary content is one of the inputs for HCI One, into which Incura practices migrate per discipline without a forced deadline. Pricing is quoted per practice; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Allied Health Therapist
primaryCustomers.description: Records and declares speech therapy, occupational therapy, exercise therapy and dietetics with discipline-specific care pathways and declaration rules in one EPD.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Uses one EPD for a multidisciplinary practice where physiotherapists share agenda and patients with other paramedical disciplines.

products.name: Evry Dietitian and Weight-consultant Practice Software
products.description: Practice software for dietitians and weight consultants from Ensemble Software in Alphen aan den Rijn, founded in 1996 and market leader for dietitians, acquired by HCI in January 2023. Evry supports the dietetics care pathway from referral to closed treatment: agenda, the dietetic dossier with NVD guideline templates, measurement instruments and progress reporting, declarations of dietetics hours through Vecozo, patient invoicing and reports back to GPs and referrers. Evry is one of the labels that HCI One consolidates in a later discipline phase, with continued support until then. Prices are quoted per practice; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Allied Health Therapist
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps dietetic records, measurements and declarations correct for the dietetics-specific rules and reports outcomes back to the GP.

products.name: ParaNICE and NICE Connect for Hospital Paramedical and Rehabilitation Care
products.type: Hospital Paramedical Registration and Remote Care (Web)
products.description: NICE Software, acquired by HCI in May 2023, brings two products: paraNICE, a multidisciplinary cloud registration system for paramedical and rehabilitation departments that works alongside hospital information systems, and NICE Connect, a remote care platform for trajectories after discharge that has been in use since 2014 with the Amsterdam UMC premature infant follow-up network and is also used by German rehabilitation centres. paraNICE covers multidisciplinary trajectory registration, scheduling and productivity reporting for the department; NICE Connect adds remote follow-up, questionnaires, video consultation and the Emogy environment for autism support. Pricing is agreed per hospital or centre; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Rehabilitation and Hospital Paramedical Coordinator
primaryCustomers.description: Coordinates multidisciplinary rehabilitation trajectories next to the hospital system and follows patients remotely after discharge.

products.name: HCI CRS All-in-one EPD for GGZ and Youth Care
products.description: The all-in-one electronic patient record for mental health care institutions, independent practitioners and youth care: client dossiers, treatment plans and multidisciplinary coordination, medication, agenda, ROM questionnaires, registration and declaration under the zorgprestatiemodel (with the mandatory referral date on every declaration from 2026) and municipal Jeugdwet and WMO contracts, a central client portal, SmartAI voice-to-text and reporting. CRS integrates with Embloom, Bergop, Therapieland, Minddistrict, ZorgDomein and ZorgMail and forms, together with Embloom and Quli, HCI's integrated GGZ proposition. HCI provides a custom quote for CRS based on the number of professionals, modules and integrations; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Independent GGZ Practitioner
primaryCustomers.description: Registers and declares under the zorgprestatiemodel first time right and treats with ROM and e-health integrated in the dossier of a small practice.

primaryCustomers.name: GGZ Institution Application Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps registration and declarations compliant across insurers and municipalities for 50 to 500 professionals and integrates the EPD with the institution's application landscape.

products.name: Uw Zorg Online Patient App and Portal
products.type: Patient App and Web Portal (Consumer, provider-paid)
products.description: The patient app and web portal that merged into HCI in June 2023 after more than 20 years, with more than 4 million users and more than 3 million app users: e-consult and secure messaging with the GP, pharmacy or therapist, appointment booking directly in the practice agenda, repeat prescriptions and the medication overview, access to records and correspondence, self-measurements and digital triage ('Moet ik naar de dokter?'). It connects to the GP and pharmacy information systems Sanday, HealthConnected, Pharmapartners, CGM, Bricks and Vertimart, carries the MedMij label and works with DigiDok and Quin. For the connected GP practices and pharmacies it is the digital front door that reduces phone traffic; HCI has also won a MedMij PGO tender for its patient environments; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Patient and Client
primaryCustomers.description: Reaches the GP, pharmacy or therapist and arranges e-consults, appointments and repeat prescriptions without calling.

primaryCustomers.name: GP Practice and Pharmacy Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Offers patients a digital front door connected to the practice's own HIS or AIS that absorbs routine contact and meets MedMij obligations.

products.name: Quli Personal Health Environment
products.description: The MedMij-labelled personal health environment acquired by HCI in September 2023 from five care organisations, NextGen Ventures and Ordina, and the fifth PGO provider to obtain the label. Quli lets citizens retrieve their data from GP, hospital and GGZ systems under MedMij consent, keep diaries and self-measurements, message and video-call their care team, use a single login for e-health apps from the GGZ appwijzer with more than 50 apps, and share information in a controlled way with family and informal carers through network care. It is used in GGZ (two of the top-50 GGZ organisations in 2025) and in intensive-care aftercare, and forms part of HCI's integrated GGZ proposition with CRS and Embloom. Quli is contracted by care organisations on quotation; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Patient and Client
primaryCustomers.description: Sees and shares health data from multiple providers on his or her own terms and keeps family and informal carers involved.

primaryCustomers.name: GGZ Institution Application Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Rolls out a MedMij-compliant client environment to all teams so clients can follow treatment and share data with their network.

products.name: Embloom E-health Platform
products.description: The e-health platform founded in 2010 as TelePsy in Maastricht by Marco Essed and acquired by HCI in July 2024, with 35 employees, more than 500 questionnaires and 450 e-health interventions, about 2,500 organisations and more than 270,000 users per year in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, certified for ISO 27001 and NEN 7510. Embloom delivers ROM and screening questionnaires, psycho-education and treatment modules, hybrid care programmes and monitoring, fully integrated in the EPD so that results land in the dossier of CRS and other systems for GGZ, POH-GGZ and somatic care. Its professional portal is used by psychologists and content developers to compose programmes; pricing is per organisation on quotation, with no list prices published.

primaryCustomers.name: Independent GGZ Practitioner
primaryCustomers.description: Sends ROM questionnaires and e-health modules from the dossier and sees results back in the treatment without a separate system.

primaryCustomers.name: GGZ Institution Application Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Rolls out blended care with a large questionnaire and intervention library to all teams and measures module usage.

products.name: Emogy Client App for Cognitive and Behavioural Support
products.description: The Emogy client app supports clients with cognitive and behavioural challenges, including the autism environment offered through NICE Connect, with structured daily routines, reminders, home tasks, mood and behaviour tracking and feedback to the treating professional. It is used within NICE Connect remote care trajectories and, in this model, within blended CRS programmes, so that the therapist sees progress between sessions and can adjust the plan, with the app's data linked to the client's trajectory in NICE Connect or the CRS dossier. Emogy is provided to clients by the care organisation as part of their treatment; terms are agreed with the care organisation on quotation and no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: Patient and Client
primaryCustomers.description: Follows the treatment programme at home with routines, tasks and reminders that fit his or her situation.

primaryCustomers.name: GGZ Institution Application Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Offers clients a supportive app between sessions whose progress data is visible to the treatment team.

products.name: Zorgverlener App for Professionals on the Go
products.description: HCI's mobile app for healthcare professionals: the agenda and today's patients on the phone, quick registration and voice notes to the dossier, patient contact through the secure messaging channel, and notifications for online bookings, cancellations and e-consults. The app authenticates through the same identity as the practitioner's HCI web application and is modeled as the mobile companion of the HCI One and label EPDs, so that the agenda and dossier a therapist sees on the phone are the same records as in the practice. The Zorgverlener App is offered alongside the practitioner's EPD; no separate list price is published.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Checks the agenda, registers treatments and answers patient messages between locations without opening a laptop.

primaryCustomers.name: Allied Health Therapist
primaryCustomers.description: Records home visits and school or municipality contacts on the go so that nothing has to be re-entered later.

products.name: Praktijkwebsites Practice Websites with Online Booking
products.description: Hosted practice websites from the Praktijkinfo portfolio, acquired by HCI in October 2023 and offered under Uw Zorg Online: template-based, accessible websites for GP practices, pharmacies and paramedical practices with content management, practice information and opening hours, and entry points for online booking, e-consult and digital triage that lead straight into the practice agenda or the Uw Zorg Online portal. The websites keep the practice findable and up to date and route patients to the digital front door instead of the phone. Websites are offered per practice on quotation; no list prices are published.

primaryCustomers.name: GP Practice and Pharmacy Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps the practice findable and up to date online and routes patients to e-consult, appointments and triage instead of the phone.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Gives the practice a website with 24/7 online booking that fills the agenda directly.

products.name: HCI Partner API and Integration Programme
products.description: The open platform through which exercise apps, questionnaire providers, quality registers, accounting and payment services and HIS/AIS vendors connect once and reach the professionals on HCI's labels: partner onboarding and agreements, API credentials and consent scopes, versioned interfaces across FysioRoadmap, SpotOnMedics, Incura, CRS and HCI One, sandbox and certification, monitoring and release coordination. Partners named by HCI include DigiDoc, HC, QUIN, ProMedico, Pharmapartners, MicroHIS, Fysio AI, PhysioTrack and Vecozo, and the labels also work with Physitrack, Qualiview, Twinfield, Mollie, Bergop, Therapieland and Minddistrict. The partner platform is the standard way to add e-health content and devices to HCI One; partner terms are agreed per partner.

primaryCustomers.name: Integration Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Integrates once with a versioned API and reaches every HCI label, with monitoring that keeps the connection reliable through releases.

products.name: Implementation, Migration, Training and Billing Services
products.type: Professional Services (Onboarding, Migration, Support, Billing Service)
products.description: The services delivered by HCI's customer operations team on top of the software: onboarding of new practices and institutions with configuration, data migration and validation, training and hypercare; the phased migration of acquired labels into HCI One with per-discipline planning; the support desk with ticket handling and knowledge base; and the outsourced billing service in which HCI submits declarations, monitors Vecozo return messages, resolves rejections and follows up patient invoices on behalf of the practice. These services are quoted per project or per practice, as HCI publishes no list prices.

primaryCustomers.name: Implementation and Support Consultant
primaryCustomers.description: Takes practices live on schedule with clean data, migrates label customers into HCI One and resolves support and return-message issues from one tooling set.

primaryCustomers.name: Physiotherapy Practice Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Hands declaration submission and return-message handling to HCI's billing service and gets an onboarding that fits the practice.
